message:
Interesting! So in the original code (commit 3ab4a32ba), there was NO `if (c == 0) break;` inside the loop. The loop would just copy until `ix` reaches `N_WORD_BYTES-1` (159), and then `word_copy[159] = 0` would be valid.

But wait - the `if (c == 0) break;` was added at some point. Let me find when it was added:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/espeak-ng && git log --all --oneline -S "break;" -- src/dictionary.cpp | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
